channel.title: Blockheight
channel.description: Blockheight reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion crypto theft; over $2.7 billion is frozen.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in Binance hack crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance as tracing and recovery efforts continue.

item.title: US gets authority to seize $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion tied to the October Binance hack, as recovery efforts continue.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, expanding the networks they can use to settle obligations.

item.title: Coinbase’s national trust bank charter takes effect
item.description: Coinbase’s national trust bank charter took effect Nov. 6, putting its crypto custody business under OCC supervision without authorizing a full-service bank.

item.title: NYSE affiliate selects Avalanche for tokenized stock settlement
item.description: Ava Labs says Avalanche will power clearing and settlement for an NYSE-linked tokenized securities venue, designed for round-the-clock trading pending approval.

item.title: Coinbase secures final OCC approval for national trust charter
item.description: Coinbase says the OCC gave its national trust company final approval on Nov. 6, placing its institutional crypto custody business under a federal charter.

item.title: Buterin shifts ETH case from fee burns to store of value
item.description: Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum should frame ETH as a store of value, arguing fee burns cannot justify its valuation without costly funding and higher fees.

item.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $80,000 as Zcash gains 11.7%
item.description: Bitcoin climbed 5.7% to $80,484 and Zcash rose 11.7% to $1,318 on Nov. 5 as traders weighed election results, market relief and a pending Zcash upgrade.

item.title: Schroders brings emerging-market bond strategy to Solana
item.description: Schroders has launched tokenized exposure to its emerging-market bond strategy on Solana with Centrifuge, marking its first deployment on the network.

item.title: Fake job interview preceded Binance’s $6.34bn hack
item.description: Binance says a fake job interview helped attackers compromise its wallets; 98% of $6.34 billion in affected assets is replenished as an outside review begins.

item.title: What to do when a cbridge transfer is pending
item.description: A pending cBridge transfer may still be confirming, delayed or awaiting a refund; check its source transaction and status before retrying or sending funds again.

item.title: Kim Yo Jong denies North Korea role in $6.4B Binance hack
item.description: Kim Yo Jong rejected the FBI’s attribution of the Oct. 29 Binance theft to TraderTraitor, while investigators trace funds and urge crypto services to block linked wallets.

item.title: Schroders takes emerging-market bond fund to Solana
item.description: Schroders’ emerging-market bond strategy is being tokenized for Solana through Centrifuge, adding sovereign and corporate debt exposure to onchain markets.

item.title: CFTC opens US market to single-stock perpetual futures
item.description: The CFTC says single-stock perpetual futures can begin trading on qualifying US exchanges, bringing a crypto trading staple into regulated equity markets.

item.title: Arbitrum council freezes $30 million tied to Binance hack
item.description: Arbitrum’s Security Council moved 8,425 ETH and 74.56 million ARB tied to the Binance exploit into a holding address, where a DAO vote now controls release.

item.title: Binance says it has covered 95% of $6.3B hack losses
item.description: Binance says it has covered 95% of losses from its $6.3 billion hack, with phased withdrawals under way and a reserve proof now available to users.

item.title: Binance says 90% of $6.3 billion hack losses are covered
item.description: Binance says it has covered 90% of assets stolen in a $6.3 billion hack, using company reserves and insurance funds as it buys the remaining tokens.

item.title: Binance puts security incident impact at $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance estimates a security incident affected $6.3 billion, says partners froze about $3 billion, and says withdrawals remain paused as investigators trace the breach.

item.title: Binance says it has replenished 90% of assets lost in $6.3B incident
item.description: Binance says it has replenished 90% of assets tied to its $6.3 billion security incident and published a new reserves snapshot, as withdrawals remain suspended.
